title: AI Tools Drive Many New Products at the CES 2025 Electronics Show
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: At this year’s CES show in Las Vegas, Nevada, crowds from around the world came to see the latest products built with artificial intelligence (AI).
sentences.zh: 今年在拉斯维加斯(内华达州)举办的CES展上, 世界各地的观众都看到最新的人工智能产品。

sentences.en: CES is produced by the Virginia-based Consumer Technology Association.
sentences.zh: CES是由设在弗吉尼亚的消费者技术协会制作的。

sentences.en: It presents the latest electronic product offerings or features , targeting consumers .
sentences.zh: 它介绍了针对消费者的最新电子产品提供或特征。

sentences.en: More than 138,000 people attended the event which ended last weekend.
sentences.zh: 超过138 000人参加了上周末结束的活动。

sentences.en: More than 4,000 companies presented products at CES 2025.
sentences.zh: 4 000多家公司在2025年欧洲交易所上市。

sentences.en: Here is a look at some of the top products shown at this year’s 2025 show: Smarter TVs?
sentences.zh: 以下是今年2025年的节目《更聪明的电视?

sentences.en: CES is historically an event at which large electronics manufacturers introduce their latest and greatest televisions.
sentences.zh: CES历来是大型电子制造商介绍其最新和最优秀的电视活动。

sentences.en: This year was no different. South Korean TV makers LG and Samsung both announced new smart models with built-in AI tools.
sentences.zh: 今年,韩国电视制作人LG和三星都公布了带有内置人工智能工具的新智能模型。

sentences.en: Others – including Japan’s Panasonic and China’s Hisense and TCL – also released TV models with new AI tools.
sentences.zh: 其他人 — — 包括日本的Panasonic和中国的Hisense和TCL — — 也发布了带有新的AI工具的电视模型。

sentences.en: Korean manufacturer LG said its latest models are equipped with AI technologies designed to autonomously improve picture brightness, sharpness and sound quality.
sentences.zh: 韩国制造商LG说,其最新模型配备了人工智能技术,目的是自主地改进图像亮度、清晰度和音质。

sentences.en: The AI improvements are powered by the company’s own a11 processer technology.
sentences.zh: 人工智能的改进是由公司自己的11号处理器技术驱动的。

sentences.en: LG also announced new updates for its Magic Remote device controller, saying new AI tools were added to provide more detailed search and interactive possibilities with users.
sentences.zh: LG还宣布了对其魔力遥控器控制器的新更新,称增加了新的人工智能工具,以提供更详细的搜索和与用户的互动可能性。

sentences.en: Samsung introduced a system called Samsung Vision AI for its line of OLED and QLED TV models.
sentences.zh: Samsung为OLED和QLED电视模式推出了一个称为Samsung Vision AI的系统。

sentences.en: The company said the AI tools are meant to turn the TVs into more “intelligent” assistive devices and to help “simplify and enrich everyday living” for its users.
sentences.zh: 该公司说,人工智能工具旨在将电视变成更“智能”的辅助装置,并帮助用户“简化和丰富日常生活”。

sentences.en: One example is a feature that permits users to click on different screen elements to receive immediate information about what they see.
sentences.zh: 一个例子是,用户可以点击不同的屏幕元素,以获得关于所看到信息的即时信息。

sentences.en: The company said another tool makes it possible to activate live language translations on-screen.
sentences.zh: 公司说,另一个工具可以启动屏幕上的现场语言翻译。

sentences.en: Transport and personal robots Several companies at CES introduced robotic transport vehicles designed to travel over many kinds of surfaces or terrain .
sentences.zh: CES的几家公司引进了机器人运输工具,用于在多种地表或地形上旅行。

sentences.en: One model was built by Kubota, a Japanese maker of farm and building equipment.
sentences.zh: 一个模型是由日本农场和建筑设备的制造者Kubota建造的。

sentences.en: The company demonstrated how the KATR four-wheeled robot uses hydraulics to control the vehicle’s four legs independently.
sentences.zh: 该公司展示了KATR四轮机器人如何使用液压设备独立控制车辆的四条腿。

sentences.en: This design seeks to keep the robot secure and level even when working on hills or in rocky areas.
sentences.zh: 这种设计试图使机器人在山上或岩石地区工作时都保持安全和平整。

sentences.en: Kubota says the vehicle – which is able to carry loads up to 240 kilograms – is small enough to be transported in most pickup trucks.
sentences.zh: 库博塔说,这辆能够运载240公斤重货物的汽车足够小,可以用大多数小卡车运输。

sentences.en: Chinese developer Unitree Robotics showed off a dog-like robot model called Go2.
sentences.zh: 中国开发商Unite Robotic 展示了一个像狗一样的机器人模型,叫做Go2。

sentences.en: The robot was designed with a series of cameras, sensors and AI tools.
sentences.zh: 机器人是用一系列摄像头、传感器和人工智能工具设计的。

sentences.en: The company says this permits Go2 to make smooth movements and automatically follow its owner.
sentences.zh: 该公司说这可以让Go2运动顺利,自动跟随其所有人。

sentences.en: It is able to carry small loads on its back and can also be used in security operations involving businesses or individuals.
sentences.zh: 它可以背上少量货物,也可以用于涉及企业或个人的安全行动。

sentences.en: Demonstrations at CES showed Go2 doing tricks, like standing on two legs, dancing and giving high fives to visitors.
sentences.zh: 在CES的示威中,Go2玩弄花招,如站着两条腿,跳舞和向游客提供击掌。

sentences.en: The company produces several other dog-like models, as well as humanoid robot s.
sentences.zh: 该公司还生产了其他几种类似狗的模型,以及人造机器人。

sentences.en: Aircraft carrier vehicle The latest flying car designs are also a yearly favorite at CES.
sentences.zh: 最新的飞行车设计也是CES每年最受欢迎的。

sentences.en: But this year, Chinese automaker XPENG took its presentation a step further by introducing a combination truck and flying vehicle.
sentences.zh: 但今年,中国汽车制造商XPENG更进一步,引进了一辆卡车和飞行器。

sentences.en: The company calls the system a Land Aircraft Carrier.
sentences.zh: 公司称这个系统为陆地航空客车

sentences.en: It includes a large transport van with enough space to transport a vertical landing flying vehicle inside.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一辆大型运输车,车内有足够空间运载垂直着陆飞行器。

sentences.en: The idea is for users to be able launch the flying vehicle from anywhere the van can go.
sentences.zh: 其想法是让用户能够 发射飞行器 从任何地方 面包车可以去。

sentences.en: The flying car is fully autonomous and can carry two people at a time.
sentences.zh: 飞行车是完全自主的 一次可以载两个人

sentences.en: Chinese media reported the company – which also offers several traditional vehicles on its website – plans to sell the combination for about $300,000.
sentences.zh: 中国媒体报导, 该公司也在其网站上提供几辆传统车辆,

sentences.en: XPENG said it will aim to increase production for all its vehicles in the coming year.
sentences.zh: XPENG说,它的目标是在来年增加其所有车辆的生产。

sentences.en: Self-charging vehicle California-based Aptera Motors demonstrated a new electronic vehicle model with a built-in charging system.
sentences.zh: 以加利福尼亚为基地的自收费车Aptera汽车公司展示了一种新的电子车辆模式,内置充电系统。

sentences.en: The company explains on its website that the vehicle has solar panels on its surface to capture energy from the sun.
sentences.zh: 该公司在其网站上解释说,该飞行器表面有太阳能电池板,从太阳中获取能量。

sentences.en: When charged this way, Aptera claims the car can travel up to 64 kilometers in a single day without being plugged in to a power source.
sentences.zh: Aptera声称,在这样收费时,汽车一天可以行驶多达64公里,但不能插上电源。

sentences.en: On a full charge, the company says the vehicle can travel up to 640 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 公司说车可以行驶到640公里

sentences.en: Salt enhancing spoon Japanese drink producer Kirin Holdings introduced a new product that aims to strengthen, or enhance, the taste of salt in food products without increasing the amount of salt.
sentences.zh: 盐加汤匙日本制酒厂Kirin Holdings推出了一种新产品,目的是在不增加盐量的情况下加强或提高食品中的盐的味道。

sentences.en: The spoon-shaped device uses electricity to increase saltiness.
sentences.zh: 勺形装置用电来增加盐度。

sentences.en: The company says the tool – which can be taken anywhere – sends a weak electric current through the top of the device to food.
sentences.zh: 公司说该工具 — — 可以在任何地方使用 — — 将微弱的电流从设备顶端输送到食物。

sentences.en: Power-assisted skis French electric sports equipment maker SQ-Motors presented an all-terrain electric board that can move on roads and snow.
sentences.zh: 法国电动运动设备制造者SQ-Motors展示了一个全地形电板,可以在道路和雪上移动。

sentences.en: The company calls its invention the Sternboard .
sentences.zh: 公司称它的发明为斯特恩板。

sentences.en: It is a three-wheeled board with an electric motor in the back.
sentences.zh: 后面有电动机的三轮板

sentences.en: First designed to be an electric skateboard, a version was developed to move on snow.
sentences.zh: 首先设计成一个电滑板,开发了一个在雪上移动的版本。

sentences.en: The powered boards have reached speeds of more than 60 kilometers per hour in tests.
sentences.zh: 充电板在测试中达到每小时60多公里的速度。

sentences.en: But the snow versions are not designed for speed.
sentences.zh: 但雪的版本不是为速度设计的。

sentences.en: They seek to provide users with the ability to go up hills or move long distances over level land.
sentences.zh: 它们设法使用户有能力上山或长途跨过平原。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from The Associated Press, AFP and online sources.
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn。Bryan Lynn根据《美联社》、AFP和网上消息,为VOA英文系撰写了这个故事。
